objective.name: sandbox.build.record
objective.description: Build a structured record payload from simple params.

#root.role: Turn simple string params into a structured record object reusable by DSL flows.

transformation_contract.morphing: Simple params become a structured record payload suitable for later DSL parameter construction.
invariants: sandbox.build.record must remain bounded by its declared inputs, outputs, and effects.
Internal implementation strategy may vary, but the declared contract surface must remain stable.
success: sandbox.build.record returns payload and matter effects consistent with the declared outputs when it succeeds.
Successful execution preserves the semantic change described by morphing.
failure: sandbox.build.record fails when required inputs or matter contracts are not satisfied.
The capacity fails when the underlying runtime or wrapper cannot satisfy the declared contract.
notes: This contract constrains expected behavior and observable effects, not the internal implementation decomposition.
Humans and LLMs should interpret the capacity through the declared interface and semantic guarantees first.
